articles.summary: At Roku, we continually work on protecting our developer machines and build servers (CI runners) from a troubling new trend: attackers slipping malicious code into popular open-source packages so that installing the package runs a script that quietly steals your credentials. If you’ve tried to defend against this, you’ve probably hit the same wall we … Continue reading "dirblock + envblock: Targeted Runtime Guards for the Credential-Harvest Era" The post dirblock + envblock: Targeted Runtime Guards for the Credential-Harvest Era appeared first on Engineering Blog .
